blogs.title: Stop Asking AI to Guess Every Time: How FeatLLM Turns LLMs into Smart Feature Engineers
blogs.description: This post explores the core paradigm shift introduced in the paper: moving away from using Large Language Models (LLMs) to predict every single data point individually. Instead, we'll explain how FeatLLM uses the LLM's reasoning power just once to act as an 'expert feature engineer,' generating a set of logical rules that transform raw data into powerful new features for a simple, fast downstream model.

blogs.title: The Cost of Intelligence: Why FeatLLM Saves You Money and Latency on Tabular Data
blogs.description: Many current AI solutions require expensive, slow API calls for every prediction. This article breaks down the economic and technical advantages of FeatLLM. We'll discuss how its 'generate once, predict forever' architecture eliminates per-sample inference costs, bypasses prompt size limits using bagging techniques, and delivers performance comparable to heavy-duty models while running on lightweight linear regressors.

blogs.title: From Text to Truth: How FeatLLM Uses Chain-of-Thought to Crack Low-Sample Tabular Problems
blogs.description: In scenarios where you have very little labeled data (few-shot learning), traditional models often fail. This deep dive explains the unique two-step prompting strategy of FeatLLM: first, leveraging the LLM's vast pre-trained world knowledge to hypothesize relationships, and second, refining those hypotheses into concrete rules using a handful of examples. We'll look at how this mimics human expert thinking to outperform state-of-the-art competitors like TabLLM and STUNT.
